parsed.explanation: No trans-specific presentation offence, facility ban, border rule, or systematic targeting is documented, so this is not a tier-1/2 case. However the same-sex offence (up to 1 year) is documented as a police lever: it deters victims reporting and some LGBTQ people have been arrested after attackers invoked their status. Public concealment is the norm, the president defended the laws, anti-gay sentiment and fliers are documented, and a harsh anti-homosexuality bill was actively promoted in Oct 2024 (outcome unresolved). That is societal and state hostility with no documented visitor-facing recourse; the 2015 labour protection is resident-facing and its enforcement is unresolved. Thin trans-specific violence data is extrapolated from criminalisation and hostility, not treated as safety. If outed, a visitor faces harassment and possible arrest with little recourse.
